verdict: unclear (carried forward from v2, now with substantially more investigation behind it, not just a repeat). Findings this run: (1) the ONLY document that ever names 宜丰-铜鼓 is the 2014-04-03 provincial DRC plan, which lists it as one of 72 then-newly-PLANNED segments -- no later approval, tender, construction, or completion notice was found anywhere (dominant docs, all 24 harvest_pool_live URLs, and targeted web searches for 核准/环评/招标/建设). (2) A materially relevant new fact: Tonggu county's actual, documented pipeline gas connection came from a DIFFERENT route -- the Wanzai-Tonggu Branch (P5888,万载-铜鼓支线; construction began 2022-03-21, gas delivered to Tonggu's distribution station 2024-10-30, per web search of tonggu.gov.cn/其它 -- see cross_row_lead to P5888) -- not from Yifeng. This raises the real possibility that the 2014-era Yifeng-Tonggu proposal was superseded by the Wanzai routing and never built, but no source explicitly cancels/shelves it, so I am not recommending a status change without a source that says so. Filing a __VALIDITY__ alongside this to flag the P4792/P5888/P4784 relationship for human adjudication rather than guessing.

Two open questions for human review, not existence/duplication concerns to act on unilaterally: (1) BOUNDARY -- the only source naming this row bundles it as '宜丰—铜鼓—修水' (Yifeng-Tonggu-Xiushui), a 110km combined figure across 3 towns, but the GEM row's endpoints are only Yifeng->Tonggu (no Xiushui, and no separate Tonggu-Xiushui row was found among sibling PIDs P4776-P4797/P5859-P5889). Length was left UNRESOLVED rather than force-apportioning the 110km. (2) LIKELY SUPERSESSION -- the county this branch would serve (Tonggu) was in fact connected to the network via a different, documented route (Wanzai-Tonggu Branch, P5888, completed 2024-10-30) with no evidence the Yifeng-origin route ever progressed past the 2014 plan stage. Not recommending deletion off this alone (per standing rule), but flagging that P4792, P5888, and possibly P4784 (Yongxiu-Wuning-Xiushui, the plan's adjacent table row) may represent a family of 2014-era routing options for the northwest Jiangxi counties of which only some were ultimately built -- worth a human pass across all three.
